events.text: Goal! Fulham 0, Chelsea 1. João Pedro (Chelsea) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Cole Palmer following a fast break.
Levi Colwill (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Roméo Lavia (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Fulham 1, Chelsea 1. Josh King (Fulham) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Timothy Castagne.
Goal! Fulham 1, Chelsea 2. Morgan Rogers (Chelsea) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Maxence Lacroix.
First Half ends, Fulham 1, Chelsea 2.
Goal! Fulham 1, Chelsea 3. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the centre of the goal. Assisted by João Pedro.
Goal! Fulham 2, Chelsea 3. Gonzalo García (Fulham) header from very close range to the top left corner.
Substitution, Chelsea. Enzo Fernández replaces Roméo Lavia.
Substitution, Chelsea. Pep Chavarría replaces Jorrel Hato because of an injury.
Substitution, Fulham. Shea Charles replaces Oscar Bobb.
Substitution, Fulham. Kevin replaces César Palacios.
Substitution, Fulham. Ryan Sessegnon replaces Sander Berge.
Reece James (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Chelsea. Pedro Neto replaces Malo Gusto.
Calvin Bassey (Fulham) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Fulham. Rodrigo Muniz replaces Antonee Robinson.
Substitution, Chelsea. Geovany Quenda replaces Morgan Rogers.
Substitution, Chelsea. Estêvão replaces Cole Palmer because of an injury.
Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
